reviews.name: Angelina Justin
reviews.text:
Over-hyped food and even worse marketing management. After a successful previous collaboration that garnered over 100k views, I was met with total unprofessionalism from their marketing team. Specifically, a representative named Varsha became disrespectful the moment I declined their lowball offer for a two-branch deal.
She attempted to insult my engagement metrics as a tactic to pressure me, then tried to play "dumb" once I called out the behavior. As an influencer, I can tell you this place is just riding on social media hype—there is absolutely nothing special about the food. Save your money; the quality doesn't justify the price, and the marketing team seriously needs a lesson in how to be nice to the people building their brand.

Hello Angelina!

We're sorry to hear this. The interaction you've described with our marketing team is not the standard we hold ourselves to and your feedback has been noted at the highest level. We'd genuinely welcome the chance to make this right.

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. Could you please email us at care@popoventures.com with your Order ID and phone number so that we can look into this further and make things right?

Warm Regards,
Paris Panini Team

reviews.name: Sarmistha Dey
reviews.text:
Visited Paris Panini recently and it turned out to be a great decision. It’s located inside a society area in Whitefield along with many other big brand outlets, so the overall vibe of the place is quite nice.

We had earlier ordered from Paris Panini through Swiggy and loved the food so much that we wanted to visit the outlet once — and I must say it was totally worth it. Every dish we tried tasted fresh and well prepared. The kitchen is open, so you can actually see your food being made, which adds a nice touch of transparency.

Out of everything we ordered, the loaded chicken fries were our absolute favorite, and the apple pie is still my all-time favorite from their menu. The staff were polite and courteous, and the ambience is comfortable for a casual meal.

One small thing to be aware of — someone outside might tell you that you need to pay for parking, but make sure you don’t pay without a proper bill. When we asked for one, he told us not to pay.

Overall, a really good place for fresh and tasty food in Whitefield.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Sarmistha!

What a beautifully detailed review - thank you, Sarmistha! The loaded chicken fries and apple pie are absolute favourites and we're so glad they delivered. Knowing you loved us on Swiggy enough to visit in person means everything to us. Your note on the parking situation is well appreciated - always ask for a bill! Hope to see you back at Paris Panini Whitefield for more fresh and tasty food soon!

Warm Regards,
Paris Panini Team
